recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, high-contrast portrait of a male figure where the right side of the face is replaced by an anatomically detailed skull. The skin on the arms appears torn or decaying, revealing skeletal structures beneath, while dark snakes coil around the limbs. The overall aesthetic is monochromatic sepia with heavy grain and deep shadows.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between human features and skeletal anatomy
Intertwining of organic snakes with human limbs
Contrast between the bright diamond jewelry and the dark, decaying background
Textural harmony between skin, bone, and scales
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and distressed texture
Centralized subject with hands clutching the head

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally framed, close-up portrait occupying 80% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The split face, specifically the transition point between the eye and the skull socket.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central face, moves outward along the coiled snakes to the hands, then down to the diamond pendant.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is filled with dark, atmospheric smoke and textured shadows.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber and charcoal shadows providing depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm sepia and tan mid-tones for skin and bone highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: High-value white for diamond reflections and teeth.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Hand-drawn, distressed sans-serif and serif mix.
letterConstructionRules: Rough, jagged edges mimicking scratched metal or bone
Inconsistent stroke widths for a raw, organic feel
Tapered terminals that look like claw marks
characterSpecificRedesigns: Elongated vertical strokes on display text
Interlocking letters in the secondary display text

composition.position: top left and top right corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Raw, hand-scratched display text paired with a clean, authoritative serif for contrast.

preserve: The scratched, hand-drawn quality of the corner text
The high-contrast serif for the central name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the aggressive, raw energy of the background text.
Provides the sharp, high-contrast serif look for the central name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast sepia portrait of a man with his hands on his head. The right half of his face should be a realistic human skull. His arms should have torn skin effects revealing bone, with dark snakes coiling around them. Add heavy film grain and a dark, smoky background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-scratched, jagged uppercase text in the top corners with a chalky texture. Place a clean, bold serif name in the center forehead area in solid white.

verificationChecks: Is the skull alignment anatomically correct with the human half?
Does the grain texture feel consistent across the image?
Is the sepia tone unified without stray colors?
Is the diamond pendant the brightest point in the lower half?

adjustableVariables: Degree of skin tearing on the arms
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness

mustAchieve: Seamless blending of skull and skin
Convincing depth in the torn skin effects

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the split-face transition is not a hard vertical line but a blended texture.
Check that the snakes appear to wrap around the volume of the arms.
Verify the text looks integrated into the environment, not just pasted on top.
Confirm the lighting on the skull matches the lighting on the human face.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject] with [Anatomical Element] using [Distressed Texture] and [Monochromatic Sepia Palette] for an [Urban Gothic] aesthetic.
